selection.rationale: Gain 20 was the only gain meeting the full -50..-10 dBm range with all gates and at least 2 dB headroom. Gain 25 also covered the full range but had only 0.37 dB headroom at -10 dBm.

limitations: All dBm values are nominal generator level minus the nominal 10 dB pad; no independent power meter was available.
The band error measurements use only -50, -30 and -10 dBm.
This is integrated CW dBFS, not an absolute traceable power calibration, noise figure or Wi-Fi BER result.
Working-band points at 2410/-50 and 2460/-50 fail the SNR gate and are retained as failures.

phase2_selection.gain_step: 5 from the beginning; fine tuning restricted to 78-82 after the coarse scan
phase2_selection.selection_rule: weakest nominal input passing the detection gates; tie-break lowest five-block power standard deviation at that input
phase2_selection.note: Gain 79 reaches the weakest tested input (-70 dBm) with the lowest block std among gains 78-82; no gain reached -75 dBm.

sensitivity.note: Thresholds are nominal DUT input. A -70 dBm threshold is the weakest detected level here; no -90 dBm threshold was found at gain 79 because source-off background set the on/off gate.

pad_overlap.note: No correction was fitted. The 50 dB readings are systematically higher than the 10 dB readings at -50 dBm, indicating a nominal-pad or setup difference of roughly 1-3 dB.

raw_adc.note: High-gain source-off background is strong at 2100, 2150, 2410, 2460 and 2600 MHz. Near-rail hits occur at 2410 and 2460 MHz. At 2800 MHz the source-on raw RMS is very high even though no reliable spectral tone is found.

fft_profiles.note: The first 80 MHz / 2048 profile attempt read -3.34 dBFS while all other profiles and a repeat read about -15.5 dBFS; the first capture was discarded as an outlier and the repeat is used.

limitations: All dBm values are nominal generator level minus the nominal 50 dB pad; no independent power meter was available.
Sensitivity is known-frequency CW detectability in this setup, not Wi-Fi BER, noise figure or a thermal-noise limit.
Source-off background and near-rail ADC hits limit several frequencies; thresholds are setup-limited.
No gain reached -90 dBm with the on/off gate; the best threshold observed was -79 dBm.
The 10 dB-pad usable-range rows reuse phase-1 data; -15 dBm was not measured because the phase-1 band scan used the requested three levels -50/-30/-10 dBm.
